children.value: > Fact From Story FTX’s co-founder and CTO Gary Wang testified Thursday on the extent to which Alameda Research was used for whatever purposes he and SBF saw fit.
> > Fact From Story The crypto trading firm, according to Wang, pulled funding directly from FTX customers, whose transactions would be funneled toward Alameda and then directed elsewhere.
> > > Fact From Story In late 2019, Alameda had a negative balance on FTX.
> > > Fact From Story Wang supervised the code change that allowed Alameda to have a negative balance.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge If a company allows a negative balance for another entity, the company is essentially providing funds to that entity.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Funneling transactions from one entity to another implies control over those transactions.
> Commonsense Knowledge A company's co-founder and CTO has the authority to direct the use of the company's resources.
